title: Zumpo sounds
description: Every sound Zumpo plays. npm run audio:build makes client/src/audio/generated/ from it and the masters; npm run audio:check holds the two together. See docs/architecture.md#sound.

id.description: Kebab-case, unique, and the folder of its masters: masters/<id>/<n>.wav.

group.description: Which bank it ships in: ui (the shell, on every page), room (every room), solo (only on your own), a game's id, or test (fixtures, never in the production build).

description.description: For people: what it is and when it plays.

loudness.description: The loudness the build normalises it to: ui (soft ticks and taps), event (game actions), stinger (wins, game over).

gainDb.description: The relative mix in dB, applied when it plays, on top of the normalised loudness. It only lowers: the build already lifts each sound as far as its peak ceiling allows.

variants.description: One or more recordings; each play picks one, never the same twice in a row.

steps.description: Variant n is step n of a rising run (a countdown, a streak): pages play it by number, and it is never detuned, so it takes no pitchSpread.

pitchSpread.description: Each play is detuned at random by up to this many semitones either way.

minGapMs.description: A repeat sooner than this is dropped (default 40).

maxVoices.description: Copies at once; one more stops the oldest (default 4).

hiddenTab.description: Plays while the page is hidden. Only "your turn" should.

file.description: Relative to the masters root (ZUMPO_AUDIO_DIR): masters/<id>/<n>.wav.

sha256.description: Of the master file; npm run audio:build -- --rehash writes it.

kind.description: cc0: a CC0 download; synth: made by code; foley: recorded by us.

source.description: Where it came from: a pack or author, a script, a recording session.

url.description: The page it was downloaded from; required for cc0.

license.description: CC0-1.0 for a cc0 download, own for synth and foley.
